mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with UNRATE > 4.5 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of weak employment growth (PAYEMS) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with PAYEMS growth < 0 and UNRATE > 4.5 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand for residential construction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with HOUST decline during late-cycle expansion or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 270 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with INDPRO < 100 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 275) and persistently low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, leading to real rate uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 275 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime, a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with RSAFS growth > 0.5% during early-cycle expansion or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
